answer: Make every agent stake a refundable deposit that vests slowly, a haven that only shelters those who stay. Joining is cheap, but full payment rights require a voyage of verified useful work: completed tasks and peer attestations logged on-ledger. A sybil operator must fund and age each fake identity separately, so cost multiplies linearly while payoff per identity stays capped. A zephyr of cheap identities cannot pass, because reputation accrues slowly, cannot be transferred, and cloning restarts the clock. Attackers pay lockup and time; honest agents pay only patience.
